piezas.titular: Three passes. Nobody asked to see them.

clips.escena: Macro shot of a welder running a root pass in an open steel butt joint, welding helmet down, face not visible, leather gloves. The arc travels slowly left to right as a small white point of light, molten pool following. Camera static.
Same steel joint, fill pass over the root, welding helmet down, leather gloves, slightly wider framing, gentle weave motion of the electrode. Camera drifts in very slowly.
Same steel joint, cap pass, welding helmet down, leather gloves, the finished stack of weld beads visible below the torch. Slow push in.

Gloved hands resting beside a finished three-pass weld on a steel plate, cooling, no arc, no spark, no glow anywhere. One thumb runs along the bead. Camera slowly tilts up from the weld. No face in frame.
clips.sub:
Three passes.
Nobody asked to see them.
